lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular spots is visible on the mid-lateral flank. Posterior to the gill slits, approximately 8 vertical columns of 4-6 primary spots each are arranged in a rectilinear pattern, transitioning to smaller, higher-density clusters toward the anterior and dorsal regions.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid where the circular blobs serve as primary nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with higher intensity above the ridge and a narrow band of shadow immediately below.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains approximately 20-25 high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, distributed across the lateral surface of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance spots that are significantly reduced in size compared to the primary lateral flank constellation.
